attr.title: Bully: Anniversary Edition
attr.desc: Bully: Anniversary Edition for AArch64 Linux handhelds through the NextOS native Android so-loader. Includes automatic low-memory and GLES2/GLES3 profiles, optimized asset streaming, native positional controller support and an optional editable GPTokeyb fallback.
attr.inst: Requires a complete, legally owned ARM64 Android copy of Bully: Anniversary Edition 1.4.311. Copy a merged APK, all APK splits from the same full installation, or a complete APKS/APKM/XAPK bundle into ports/bully/gamedata and launch once to validate and extract it. Game files are not included.
